title: n-Dimensional Sperner: Boundary-Door Oddness by Dimensional Induction

problemStatement.plain: Formal investigation in combinatorics: n-Dimensional Sperner: Boundary-Door Oddness by Dimensional Induction.

currentState.focus: Option C, Phase-1 carrier. This session lifts the interior Freudenthal pivot toward CanonSimplex: pivot_base_eq (the pivot fixes the lex-base verts 0, since it only updates verts a.succ and a.succ ≠ 0) and pivot_isCanon_iff (canonicality of the pivot reduces to ONE lex test — the moved pivot point dominating the shared base — instead of d+1 conditions). Both VERIFIED 0-axiom (lake env lean exit 0; #print axioms = [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]). This isolates exactly the recanonicalization criterion the CanonSimplex-level adj construction needs: the interior pivot already lands on the canonical representative iff that single comparison holds. Remaining for a full SpernerTriangulation instance: the adj search function (with recanonicalization when the pivot is non-canonical) + adj_symm/adj_vertices/adj_ne/boundary_face.
blockers: The remaining open frontier is the adj field: a facet-adjacency function Simplex → Fin (d+1) → Option (Simplex × Fin (d+1)) realising the Freudenthal pivot, plus its 5 compatibility fields (adj_symm, adj_vertices, adj_ne, adj_unique_facet, boundary_face). facet_injective supplies the within-cell half of adj_unique_facet; the cross-cell half needs canon_eq_of_vertices_range. Estimated ~300-500 lines.

insights: SpernerNDim.lean is complete (669 lines, 0 sorries): structure SpernerTriangulation (8 fields) + theorem sperner_ndim (line 654) which yields a fully-colored simplex from an odd count of last-face boundary doors. This is the exact finish line for sperner_grid.

Last-face boundary doors of the d-grid are in bijection with panchromatic (d-1)-simplices of the induced (d-1)-Freudenthal grid on face d: adj=none + boundary_face puts the facet on face d; the Sperner condition forbids color d there; isDoorAt = all colors {0..d-1} present = IsFC for the (d-1)-grid. Induction + sperner_parity at d-1 gives oddness. Base d=0: count 1.

Coordinate bridge: abstract framework uses Vertex d N (Fin d -> N, sum<=N, Kuhn coords); SpernerGrid uses BaryPoint d N (Fin (d+1) -> N, sum=N). They are canonically isomorphic; proving BaryPoint d N ≃ Vertex d N (~30-50 lines, no adjacency) is the cleanest standalone first deliverable and unlocks reuse of the whole framework.

Phase-1 instance must use unoriented Kuhn cells (base point + permutation of increment order, one representative per geometric cell). The Session-1 orientation-doubling bug came from carrying a free miss/orientation flag in GridSimplex; the instance must NOT.

Session 5: representation A (GridSimplex subtype) preferred over Finset for the Phase-1 Simplex type — Finset does not dodge the canonical vertex-ordering obligation; IsCanon s := forall k, lex (s.verts 0) <= s.verts k is a simpler computable canonicality predicate (step_dec fixes chain direction from lex-min base).

Phase-1 GridSimplex-rep REQUIRES canonicalization: a facet-sharing dual graph over all GridSimplices breaks adj_unique_facet (a cell and its reverse share the same vertex set/facets). Cube-Kuhn lex-min-base uniqueness does NOT transfer (corner-simplex is not a union of full Kuhn cubes), so a separate IsCanon predicate is mandatory.

The chain-interior facet (delete vertex a.succ, 0<a.succ<d) always has a neighbour: swap the two consecutive increment steps a,b (b.castSucc=a.succ). Only the middle vertex moves to the opposite corner verts(a.castSucc)+e_{incDir b}-e_miss; the miss coordinate is untouched at every vertex (so step_dec is inherited verbatim), and only steps a,b have a moved endpoint. This is the GridSimplex-level EXISTENCE half of the search-based adj boundary_face obligation (an interior facet must have a partner).
Pitfall: subst hka with hka:k=a eliminates a (replacing a by k), not k — breaks references to the def binder a. Use rw [hka] (and rw [hka] at hjI ⊢) instead to keep a.
Pitfall: nat (x+1)+0 is defeq x+1, so rw/simp auto-closes such goals by rfl — a trailing omega then errors with No goals.
